item.title: Senior band students take Chicago
item.description: Senior band students take Chicago Image Publisher Mon, 03/23/2026 - 09:17 Over this past weekend, seniors from the Denmark High School Band traveled with Band Director Andy Pagel to the Windy City on a special trip. While in Chicago, students attended a candlelit performance by a professional string quartet, explored the Miracle Mile and visited the Shed Aquarium, Willis Tower and Alder Planetarium. item.title: Denmark Youth Wrestlers make impressive showing at state
item.description: Denmark Youth Wrestlers make impressive showing at state Image Publisher Mon, 03/23/2026 - 09:17 On March 14 and 15, the Denmark Wrestling Club competed in this year’s Wisconsin Wrestling Federation Kids Team State Tournament in Wisconsin Dells. The local wrestlers made an impressive showing with the 3rd-5th Grade Team placing 3rd out of 16 teams and the 6th-8th Grade Team placing 7th out of 16 teams. Congratulations boys! (Photo courtesy of John Goral) Sports
